answer: Registration binds each identity to a 1000-unit bond locked to one hardware attestation key, with the key hash entered once per device into the garden registry. A sybil attacker must lock 1000 units per fake identity, forfeits 100 percent on detection, and waits 30 epochs to withdraw. Splitting identities multiplies the marginal bond cost per fake key while independent jurors on the meadow and prism nodes share slashing evidence across forks.
